_description: Master feature list for the Futuraria Design Harness. The Leader reads this for PLANNING. The Kanban (design_kanban_tasks in Supabase) is the source of truth for STATUS. Use studio_list_cards for live status.

_rules.source_of_truth: Kanban (Supabase/studio_list_cards) = live status. feature_list.json = planning guide.
_rules.one_at_a_time: Only one task can be 'in_progress' at any time. harness_claim_feature enforces this server-side.
_rules.implementer_pick: Implementers pick ONE pending task from this list. They never create tasks — only the Leader creates via studio_create_card.
_rules.cronjobs_optional: Cronjobs are OPTIONAL. Not every feature needs one. Only create cronjobs for recurring tasks.

features.title: Diseño de post 1080×1080
features.brief: Crear un diseño para Instagram 1080×1080 con estilo moderno
